scope: Four independent 40-frame live ROS throughput measurements of one frozen implementation, with stiffness identification enabled. No offline replay. This is not a full-trajectory applicability certificate or a measurement of RViz GPU frame rate.

assessment.limitation: The auxiliary stable branch can end at a fold during longer runs. Such updates publish posterior=null, exact retained_prior and unavailable information. A successful short measurement does not remove those reported limitations.

scene_clock: wall time; hold the last command until the next completed fresh update

replication.load_note: Other demo preparations ran concurrently. The logical CPU was selected after a short utilization sample; affinity does not establish an isolated or idle CPU.

source_fingerprint_policy: A single baseline was taken at process start and compared at the start/end of every case. All four cases and the archival-time files matched that same baseline.

stiffness_settings.known_model_source: Generated shared robot URDF, including its supplied masses/inertias and known tool/camera attachments, with deflecomp gravity and linear joint spring law. These are inputs of the auxiliary model, not quantities learned from observations. The simulator's true stiffness and realized pose are excluded.

parameter_prior_source.bounds_role: existing Gaussian initialization only; not truncation of log-K support

interpretation: The stiffness posterior describes effective parameters of the supplied auxiliary gravity/spring model. It is not a guarantee of material stiffness. Every saved Gaussian-mixture component and its full covariance is retained below.
parameter_delivery: Full log-K means/covariances and all Gaussian-mixture components, with K medians. Optional linear-K means/covariances are not required delivery fields.

initial_parameter_prior.representation: Gaussian mixture in log K; x_est/P_est are mixture moments
initial_parameter_prior.parameterization: x = log(K / (1 N m/rad)); P_est is the full dimensionless log-K covariance

first_parameter_posterior.representation: Gaussian mixture in log K; x_est/P_est are mixture moments
first_parameter_posterior.parameterization: x = log(K / (1 N m/rad)); P_est is the full dimensionless log-K covariance

final_update_parameter_prior.parameterization: x = log(K / (1 N m/rad)); P_est is the full dimensionless log-K covariance

final_parameter_posterior.representation: Gaussian mixture in log K; x_est/P_est are mixture moments
